notes:
1. [修復與穩定性] 修復從網頁瀏覽器拖曳圖片時因 OLE 虛擬檔案誤判與剪貼簿衝突導致當掉的問題
2. [非同步載入] 網頁遠端圖片全面採用背景非同步執行緒下載，UI 主執行緒零卡頓零凍結
3. [圖片支援] 支援 Base64 Data URL 圖片解析解碼入架，支援多種圖片二進位點陣圖格式
notes_en:
1. [Fix & Stability] Fixed freeze/crash when dragging images from web browsers due to OLE descriptor collision and clipboard lock
2. [Async Download] Asynchronous background downloading for remote web images, completely non-blocking UI
3. [Image Support] Added Base64 Data URL decoding support and native binary image drop handling
